shots.focal_element: The 'Brand kit Beta' item in the bottom-left corner of the workspace sidebar, where the cursor rests
shots.transition_other: Detector flagged a non-cut change; the first sampled frame (0:16.5) is framed slightly wider than 0:17.0, so the shot appears to open mid camera-scale rather than on a clean cut
shots.typography: Native product UI: regular-weight humanist sans in sentence case for sidebar items and card titles (white or dark on coloured cards), small grey counts, small-caps-style uppercase 'SHARED' section label with wide tracking, tiny pill badge 'Beta'. Font guess (low confidence): Typeform's Apercu-like grotesk.
shots.what_happens: A zoomed-in screen recording of the Typeform workspace grid of coloured form cards; the cursor sits on 'Brand kit' (Beta) in the bottom-left sidebar while the VO says 'click here in the bottom-left corner of your workspace' (w36-w45); in the last frame the workspace fades out to white as the Brand kits page begins to appear.
shots.build_rebuild: Render a 1280x720 recording of the workspace scaled ~1.3x and anchored bottom-left so the 'Brand kit' sidebar row sits near the lower-left edge, park the cursor on it for ~2.5 s, then cross-fade the whole frame to the next page over ~0.5 s.

shots.focal_element: The black 'Create brand kit' button under the 'Brand kits' heading
shots.typography: UI text: medium-size regular sans heading 'Brand kits' in sentence case; white-on-black small button label with a plus glyph; card title regular weight. Modal title in a light, slightly larger sans. Font guess (low confidence): Apercu-like grotesk.
shots.what_happens: The Brand kits page dissolves in over the faded workspace, showing an existing 'Headphone Corp' kit card; the camera pushes in from a wide view to a tighter top-left framing while the cursor travels to and clicks 'Create brand kit' (VO w46-w53); the last frame shows the 'Name this brand kit' modal over a dark scrim.
shots.build_rebuild: Cross-fade the Brand kits page in over a 70% white-washed workspace, animate a scale-up of ~1.3x anchored at the top-left heading over ~1 s, move a cursor to the 'Create brand kit' button and click, then open a centred modal on a dark overlay.

shots.focal_element: The 'Name this brand kit' modal and its text field
on_screen_text: Upload the logo from you company and start using it on your typeforms.
Upload your company colors and create different color palettes.
Add any image, icon, or media from your company brand kit.
shots.typography: Modal title in a light-weight sans, sentence case, normal tracking; input text and 'Continue' button label in regular sans, button white on near-black; dimmed background section titles in regular sans with smaller grey description lines. Font guess (low confidence): Apercu-like grotesk.
shots.what_happens: Centred white modal on a dark scrim: the default 'My brand kit' text is selected and replaced by typing 'Tropical Hotel Group' letter by letter (typing SFX x007/x008 around 24.8-25.6 s), the cursor clicks 'Continue' and the scrim lifts to reveal the new kit's Logos/Colors/Media page; VO 'First, we'll give it a name' (w54-w59).
shots.build_rebuild: Show a centred modal over a ~80% black overlay, select-all the placeholder, type 'Tropical Hotel Group' at ~4 characters per 0.5 s with a blinking caret and key-click SFX, click 'Continue', then fade the overlay out to the underlying page.

shots.focal_element: The Logos card and its '+' Add button, later the new logo collection row
on_screen_text: Upload the logo from you company and start using it on your typeforms.
Upload your company colors and create different color palettes.
Add any image, icon, or media from your company brand kit.
Upload or drop an image right here
shots.typography: Native UI: small breadcrumb and tab labels in regular sans; card titles in medium-size regular sans; grey descriptions in smaller regular sans; black tooltip 'Add' with white small text; editable collection name in an inline text field. Font guess (low confidence): Apercu-like grotesk.
shots.what_happens: The new 'Tropical Hotel Group' kit page holds wide for ~5 s with an idle cursor while VO explains assets (w60-w84); around 33 s the view pushes in on the three cards; the cursor hovers the Logos '+' (tooltip 'Add'), creates 'New logo collection', renames it 'Tropical Hotel Group' by typing (click/typing SFX x010-x013, 36.9-38.7 s), clicks the row's '+', a 'Media Gallery' upload panel opens, and at the end a macOS file picker drops in over a dimmed page (VO 'I'll upload my logo in two different colors', w85-w92).
shots.build_rebuild: Hold the full page wide, then over ~1 s ease a scale-up of ~1.6x centred on the card stack, script cursor hover with a dark tooltip, insert a new row under Logos, type the collection name in the inline field with key SFX, then open a side panel and a system file dialog over a grey overlay.

shots.focal_element: The macOS file picker listing four THG logo PNG files
shots.typography: macOS system dialog in the system sans (San Francisco-like, low confidence), regular weight, sentence/title case; filenames in regular weight with small file-type icons; dimmed product UI behind.
shots.what_happens: A 1.2 s bridge shot of the macOS open-file dialog showing the 'THG Logos' folder with Black, Pink, Turq and White logo files; the cursor is idle and in the second frame the next scene (the uploaded logos page) is already cross-fading through the dialog. No VO words fall in this shot.
shots.build_rebuild: Overlay a static mock of a system file dialog (four filename rows) on a 30% grey-dimmed page for ~1.2 s, then cross-fade over ~0.5 s directly to the result state, skipping the actual file selection.
